title: Three Springs and One Short Fence
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（人与自然·自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（人与自然·自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：habitat　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 habitat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the warden ① fenced a habitat that no visitor in the wood would have described, and he said the fencing was the whole of the spring. The ② habitat, meaning the ground itself and not the map, ran three springs and stayed undescribed in the book; a habitat, he said, is the only thing in a wood that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ habitat in that wood had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ habitat at the far pond, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A habitat, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the warden said the describing is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the habitat was the whole of the matter, meaning the home and not the ground. The ⑥ habitat, meaning the home and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; habitat, he said, is either something you fence or the only word that means both a ground and a home. He said the home is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ habitat had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ habitat of the whole thing, the warden wrote in November, was one wood and three springs of describing; habitat, he said, is either the one at the far pond or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ habitat I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1980 and is still described as the quietest in the wood. A ⑩ habitat, my mother said in 1982, is the only one that improves by being described; every habitat, she said, is a home that has agreed to look like a ground. She said the home was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 栖息地（指林地中每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 栖息地（指那片土地本身，与地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：fence a habitat 围起一处栖息地
D. n. 栖息地（指留给孩子们观察的那一处）
E. n. 生境（抽象总称，指一片林地的栖息地之事）
F. n. 栖息地（指方案里写到、被记录过的那一处）
G. n. 产地；居所（指一件事里人人都寻却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 栖身之所（抽象总称，指人人都寻却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fenced a habitat that no visitor in the wood would have described
The habitat, meaning the ground itself and not the map
the habitat at the far pond
the habitat was the whole of the matter
the habitat had become a line in a plan
The habitat of the whole thing
A habitat, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: fence a habitat 意为“围起一处栖息地”，1973 年那位管理员围起了林地中没有一位游客肯描述的一处栖息地。
habitat 意为“栖息地”，指那片土地本身而不是地图，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被描述。
habitat 意为“栖息地”，指林地中每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
habitat 意为“栖息地”，指最远那个池塘边留给孩子们观察的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
habitat 意为“产地、居所”，指一件事里人人都寻却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片居所就是那件事的全部。
habitat 意为“栖身之所”，指人人都寻却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片土地，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
habitat 意为“栖息地”，指方案里写到、被记录过的那一处，到 1978 年这一处成了方案里的一行。
habitat 意为“生境”，管理员十一月写道，整件事的栖息地之事是一片林地和三个春天的描述。
habitat 意为“栖息地”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那一处，1980 年划定了，至今仍被说成林地中最安静的一处。
habitat 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，栖息地是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的地方。
